name: select
purpose: Select control for choosing exactly one option from a list; several values are `multi-select`. The trigger field mirrors `Input`'s visual API (size, hover/focus/filled/disabled/invalid/required states) so a Select sits next to a TextInput without visual drift. The dropdown panel is teleported to `body` and anchored to the trigger by the shared `usePlacement` composable — no `@floating-ui` runtime. A selected option shows a trailing check (`az az-check`) (the shadcn pattern), optionally a leading slot/icon and a trailing tag. The trigger shows the selected option's label (each option records its text, as Radix `SelectValue` does), not its raw value. Search and "Create new" footer are exposed as slots on `<SelectContent>`. Aligned with Figma frames `3714:10801` (trigger states) and `3899:29361` (options panel).
useWhen: Use Select to pick exactly one value from a list of more than about seven options. For several values use MultiSelect; when the person may type a value that is not in the list use Combobox; for two to seven options shown at once use RadioGroup.
One value from a list too long to show inline (regions, runtimes, plans).
Options grouped under headings, with icons or trailing tags.
A list that needs a search box or a "Create new" action inside the panel.
avoidWhen: A select with a visible label and helper/error text in a form → put it inside a `field`; the trigger picks up the field's id, description and state.
The field is always multi-pick → use `multi-select`.
Two to seven options that fit on screen → use `radio-group` (`variant="card"` for cards).
The list triggers actions or navigation instead of holding a value → use `dropdown-menu`.
related: `field` — label, this select, and description/error, with the wiring done.
`multi-select` — multi-only variant with checkbox rows and an array model.
`dropdown-menu` — action menu that reports the chosen option as an event and holds no form value.
`input-group` — joins a select to an input, such as currency plus amount.
bestPractices: Render `Select.Trigger` and `Select.Content` inside the root; the parts read the root's context and throw outside it.
Give each `Select.Item` a stable `value`; pass `displayValue` to control how the trigger renders the selection.

Type an options list as `SelectOptionItem<string>[]` and render it with `v-for` into `Select.Item` (`:value`, `:icon`, `:disabled`, the `label` as the slot); bind a typed model so `displayValue` and `update:modelValue` take that type with no cast.
Use `readonly` to show a fixed selection and `disabled` when the field is unavailable; neither opens the panel.

A switcher inside a line of text, such as the environment that ends a resource's breadcrumb (`Workloads › workload_01 › Production ⌄`), is `variant="ghost"` with `size="small"` and an `aria-label` on `Select.Trigger`: no border or fill until hover, sized to its value. Never put a bordered field in the header, and never restyle the trigger with `!` overrides.
Keep `variant="ghost"` out of forms: it draws no border, so it cannot show the `invalid` or `required` border; a form field is the default `outline` inside a `Field`.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Trigger placeholder shown when no option is selected.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects trigger height (small=28px, medium=32px, large=40px) matching `Input`.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Trigger look: `outline` is the bordered field; `ghost` has no border or fill until hover, sized to its value, for a switcher inside a line of text such as the environment at the end of a breadcrumb.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the trigger and prevents opening; applies disabled tokens.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Marks the field read-only; the current selection is visible but the dropdown cannot open.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required; applies the required (warning) border and sets `aria-required` on the trigger, matching `Input`. The label's Required tag is owned by the wrapping form-field, not by this component.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Applies the invalid border + ring tokens and sets `aria-invalid` on the trigger.

props.name: displayValue
props.doc: Custom formatter used by the trigger to render the selection; receives the current `modelValue`, typed as the bound model. Unset, the trigger shows the selected options' labels.

props.name: name
props.doc: Form field name. Set, the root renders one hidden input per selected value (`String(value)`, objects as JSON) so a native `form` and `FormData` submit the selection; `required` then adds a hidden required proxy that blocks an empty submit, and `disabled` leaves the value out, as a native control does.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Composition slot; receives `<SelectTrigger>` and `<SelectContent>` (and the option tree inside it).
